elements.description: Everything an agent changed, newest first, each change with an Undo that takes what builds on it along.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the list's name

properties.name: agent
properties.description: Who made the changes – e.g. "Launch agent"

properties.name: entries
properties.description: The changes the agent made, in any order – the ledger lists them newest first

properties.name: now
properties.description: The clock for "2m ago", in epoch ms – unset, the element keeps its own clock

properties.name: pointAt
properties.description: Lights up a change and what builds on it, as if its Undo were pointed at – e.g. for a walkthrough

properties.name: onUndo
properties.description: Called with the ids an Undo takes back; a returned promise holds the rows until it settles, a rejection reverts them

properties.name: onRedo
properties.description: Called with the ids a Redo brings back; a returned promise holds the rows until it settles, a rejection reverts them

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-undone-change
events.description: The undone ids changed (`{ undone: string[] }`, the whole new list); cancelable – prevent it to keep `undone` as it is (controlled use)

events.name: tc-undo
events.description: A change was undone (`{ ids: string[] }`: the change and its reversible dependents)

events.name: tc-redo
events.description: A change was redone (`{ ids: string[] }`: the change, what went with it and the undone changes it builds on)

props.name: entries
props.description: The changes the agent made, in any order – listed newest first; `icon` may be a React node

props.name: now
props.description: The clock for "2m ago", in epoch ms – defaults to an internal clock

props.name: undone
props.description: Ids of undone changes. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps them, starting from `defaultUndone`

props.name: defaultUndone
props.description: Ids undone at first when uncontrolled

props.name: onUndoneChange
props.description: Every change to the undone ids, as the whole new list

props.name: onUndo
props.description:
Undo sends the change and its reversible dependents, Redo the same set back – plus any undone changes that set
builds on. Either may return a promise: the rows show the result at once and wait; if it rejects they go back
and the bar says so

props.name: onRedo
props.description: Called with the ids a Redo brings back; a returned promise holds the rows until it settles, a rejection reverts them

props.name: pointAt
props.description: Lights up a change and what builds on it, as if its Undo were pointed at – e.g. for a walkthrough

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the list's name – "Ledger" by default
